name: Human
description: Found throughout the multiverse, humans are as varied as they are numerous. Their ambition, adaptability, and resourcefulness are respected—and sometimes feared—across many worlds.

grants.name: Resourceful
grants.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

grants.name: Skillful
grants.description: Gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

grants.name: Versatile
grants.description: Gain one Origin feat of your choice. Skilled is recommended.
